verified_notes: Muslim Library's current Swahili page lists 10,447 books and includes multiple Swahili Islamic titles, making it a concrete Swahili search lane.
Islamic Foundation Bangladesh officially describes a central library with about 130,000 books and pamphlets, including Quran, tafsir, hadith, encyclopedias, Islamic law, history and related subjects.
Islamic Foundation Bangladesh publishes an official 2025 book list and its research department reports publication of research books on Quran, hadith, fiqh and Islamic subjects.
Hadeeth Foundation Bangladesh has an active online library with books in Bengali and other languages and online-reading entries.
El-Kalem is the publishing center of the Islamic Community in Bosnia and Herzegovina and has dedicated categories for Quran/tafsir, hadith/seerah, aqidah and sharia law.
As-Sunnah.nl, Japan Islamic Trust, Japan Islamic Association and Korea Muslim Federation are preserved as regional discovery lanes; item-level rights must be verified before redistribution.
The Clear Publishing is preserved as a Spanish-language publishing lane; publisher-controlled works must not be assumed freely redistributable.
Wolof, Bambara, Maranao, Tagalog, Albanian, Bosnian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Portuguese are treated as independent search-language lanes rather than merely translation metadata.
required_behavior: Do not delete or replace previously saved sources when these regional sources are added.
Search saved regional/language sources before generic web discovery for matching language and subject queries.
Preserve provenance, edition, language and item-level rights for every acquired work.
Do not infer public redistribution rights from online availability or from an institution being governmental/nonprofit.
For manuscripts, preserve the complete digital surrogate when legally obtainable; OCR remains a search aid and not the authoritative surrogate.
